# North Eastern Mindanao State University

> North Eastern Mindanao State University (NEMSU) is a public, multi-campus university serving Surigao del Sur, Philippines through instruction, research, innovation, extension, and public service.

## Official resources

- [University profile](https://nemsu.edu.ph/about/university): History, mandate, vision, mission, and core values.
- [Academic affairs](https://nemsu.edu.ph/academics/academic-affairs): Colleges, graduate studies, academic programs, and offices.
- [Campuses](https://nemsu.edu.ph/campuses/tandag): Entry point for NEMSU's seven campuses.
- [Newsroom](https://nemsu.edu.ph/news): Official university news and press releases.
- [Announcements](https://nemsu.edu.ph/announcements): Official notices and public advisories.
- [Research, innovation, and extension](https://nemsu.edu.ph/research-innovation-extension): Research centers, publications, innovation, and extension programs.
- [Online services](https://nemsu.edu.ph/services): Official student, employee, and stakeholder services.
- [University directory](https://nemsu.edu.ph/directory): Contact information for university offices and officials.

## Discovery

- [XML sitemap](https://nemsu.edu.ph/sitemap.xml): Canonical list of indexable public pages.
- [Robots policy](https://nemsu.edu.ph/robots.txt): Crawler access policy.

Content on third-party sites should not be treated as an official NEMSU statement unless the university website links to it.
